messages:
lina: Quick sync — can we run a short canary rerun for the paged-attn + Flash fused ops experiment? Saw a small 5-15% p95 spike on some customer traces yesterday, want to validate before rolling to canary.
ben: Ack. Can you paste the exact config and seed traces you want? I can queue a 30m run on dedicated-qa.
lina: Use model=redwood-40b-v1-qat, seq=2048, batch=1/2 (both), kv_cache_prefetch=on, fusion_level=auto. Target workload: mix of short (128) + long (2k) prefixes. Capture nvtx + heaptrace.
anya: Adding: please enable "paged-eviction-check" in env so we catch KV cliff. Also set --warmup-iters=50 so the cv warms.
ben: Got it. I'll run two variants: (A) flash+paged fused (current patch), (B) baseline (no fusion). Will upload traces and flamegraphs.
simon: FYI also set perf-runner-bot to collect cpu/gpu utilization every 5s: `--sample-interval=5s`. Last run missed the mem-surge window.
perf-runner-bot: Scheduling run 2115009999-1 on dedicated-qa (g5-8x). Command:
```
run_bench --model redwood-40b-v1-qat --seq 2048 --batch 1,2 --fusion auto \
  --kv-prefetch on --paged-eviction-check true --warmup-iters 50 \
  --nvtx true --heaptrace true --sample-interval 5s --out /runs/2115009999/
```
perf-runner-bot: Started. ETA ~32m. Tracking: https://redwood-internal/runs/2115009999-1
lina: Awesome. Ben — when you post the flamegraphs can you also annotate where the p95 jump happens? :eyes:
ben: Will do. If we see repeated KV eviction spikes around token 1200 that's the likely culprit.
anya: Quick ask for reviewers: if the canary looks good, do we want to enable fusion_level=aggressive for gpu-coldstart only, or leave auto? I'd prefer conservative rollout.
simon: Conservative sounds fine. Maybe enable aggressive on canary-2 (different region) only.
ben: Run finished. Uploading artifacts: /runs/2115009999-1/{nvtx.trace,heaptrace.pb,flame.svg,profile.json}. Quick summary: p95 delta vs baseline = +12% on long-prefix subset, p50 unchanged.
lina: Link?
ben: https://redwood-internal/runs/2115009999-1/results.html — flame.svg has annotations. TL;DR shows KV slab reorg at ~1.2k tokens causing stalls.
anya: Seeing the same in heaptrace. My theory: the fusion schedule touches a path that forces a sync on eviction. Could add an async-evict flag to patch.
simon: Can we repro locally with smaller hardware? Maybe an emulated eviction step.
ben: I can try a small repro with seq 2048 but batch=1 on a 3090; should show the timing if it's algorithmic.
lina: OK plan: Ben to open an RFC PR with patch toggles (async-evict flag), attach traces + suggested rollout (canary-2 in eu-west). Anya to validate heaptrace mapping. Simon to prepare perf dashboard panel for this metric. We'll reconvene in thread when PR is up.
ben: Starting PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4287 . Includes run links and a small microbench.
anya: Reviewing now. Quick note: add a test that toggles paged-eviction-check off/on so CI can catch regressions.
simon: I'll add the dashboard query: metric:runtime.kv_evictions.count, grouped by model, region, fusion_level.
lina: Thanks all. If anyone notices customer-facing errors, ping #incidents. Otherwise update thread with PR review notes.
ben: Marking for follow-up: will post canary-2 results here. :thumbsup:
